profile: CTS Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells sensors, connectivity components, and actuators for original equipment manufacturers, tier-one suppliers, distributors, and the U.S. Government. Its products include controls, pedals, sensors, switches, transducers, filters, capacitors, frequency-control products, resistors, and rotary and piezo microactuators. They serve transportation, industrial, medical, and aerospace and defense applications, with sales supported by engineers, independent representatives, and distributors.
